children: The Ibovespa fell about 1% to trade below 185,500 on Monday amid a rebound in the oil rally and persistent political uncertainty.
Oil prices rose after Saudi Arabia shut down a crucial pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz.
Renewed energy-driven inflationary pressures ahead of interest-rate decisions by the BCB and the Fed weighed on credit-sensitive stocks.
Financials were mostly lower, with Banco do Brasil down more than 1%, while Itaú, Bradesco, B3 and Caixa shed about 2% each.
Utilities also moved lower, with Axia losing 2% and Sabesp falling 2.5%.

Political uncertainty remained elevated amid the ongoing Supreme Court crisis, while a new Datafolha poll showed President Lula maintaining a numerical lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential October runoff.
Vale fell near 2% as ion ore prices in China closed lower.
Petobras (+1%) was the only positive highlight.

title: Ibovespa Drops on Oil Rally and Political Risks
